title: Find the Missing Number
description:
You are given n distinct integers taken from the range 0..n (inclusive). Exactly one number from that range is missing. Find it.

Input format
Line 1: n.
Line 2: n distinct integers.

Output format
The missing integer.
constraints: 1 <= n <= 100000. Every value is between 0 and n and all values are distinct.
hints: There are n + 1 numbers in the range 0..n but only n are given. What do you know about the sum of the full range?
The sum of 0..n is n*(n+1)/2. Subtract the sum of the given numbers.
Alternatively XOR every index 0..n with every value: pairs cancel and only the missing number remains.

examples.explanation: The range is 0..3 and 2 is absent.
The range is 0..2, so the missing number is 2.
